input.question: Who is the main actor in the film "Let George Do It"?

documents.text: Let George Do It (1938 film) Let George Do It is a 1938 comedy starring popular stage comedian George Wallace. It was the first of two films Wallace made for Ken G. Hall at Cinesound Productions, the other one being "Gone to the Dogs" (1939). Hall later called Wallace "in my opinion, easily the best comedian that this country has produced." The plot concerns a man, Joe Blake, who works as a stage hand in a vaudeville theatre headlined by Mysto the magician.
